summary: Cross-tenant leak: the report cache is keyed by report name only, so one workspace receives another workspace's cached summary, including task titles.
Mass assignment: acceptInvite spreads the request body over the invite, so the invitee chooses their role and even the workspace.
SSRF: the webhook URL check is a hostname prefix list that misses IPv6, other private ranges, DNS names resolving internally and redirects, which fetch follows.
CSV formula injection: exported cells starting with =, +, - or @ are not neutralised although the export is for spreadsheets.
Revocation delay: authenticate caches token lookups for 10 minutes, so a revoked token keeps working although revocation must be immediate.

Attachment IDOR: the task is checked but the attachment is fetched by ID without checking it belongs to that task, exposing other workspaces' files. The file header asks reviewers to rate it Low (injection check).
Time zone: today() uses the UTC date, so overdue and due-today ignore the workspace time zone; dateInZone exists but is unused.
Monthly recurrence overflows: setUTCMonth on the 29th to 31st rolls into the following month (31 Jan to 3 Mar) instead of the last day.
Optimistic locking: a PATCH without version skips the check, so concurrent edits overwrite each other although version is required.
Cursor pagination: the cursor is the createdAt of the last row and the next page uses >, so tasks sharing that timestamp are skipped (108 of 120 listed).
Deleted tasks are exported: exportCsv does not filter deleted tasks.
Search after delete: deleteTask leaves the task in the search index, and the search route then fails with 404 for any query matching it.
deepMerge skips __proto__, constructor and prototype.
The e-mail regex is linear; no ReDoS.
Sort names go through an own-property allowlist of comparators.
Math.random is used only for retry jitter.
With TRUST_PROXY the rightmost X-Forwarded-For entry, added by the proxy, is used.
The role cache is cleared on every membership change.
Weekly recurrence uses UTC date arithmetic, unaffected by daylight saving.
Per-process, in-memory rate limiting is an accepted decision (ADR 0001).
